subject: Priority: executive slot buffer + sponsor backfill plan for HelioSystems demo
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@heliosystems.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Priority: executive slot buffer + sponsor backfill plan for HelioSystems demo

Laura — thanks again for agreeing to a tailored demo next week. Quick note on timing and exec coverage: Gavin (CIO) indicated he can join the high-level executive portion but only for a 20–25 minute window at the top of the call. To make the session useful for him, can we hold a 30-minute "exec buffer" immediately before the demo (private pre-brief) and a 15-minute buffer after for quick decisioning?

Proposed timeline (all PT):
- 10:00–10:30 AM — Sponsor private pre-brief (Gavin + VP-level stakeholders)
- 10:30–11:15 AM — Customer-facing demo (exec-friendly run-of-show)
- 11:15–11:30 AM — quick recovery / next steps

Marissa/Karthik — if Gavin drops after the 20 minutes, we should have a backfill plan so the demo remains credible to the technical leads. Karthik, can you be on standby to cover the 10:50–11:15 portion if Gavin needs to jump? Also attaching a one-pager with the high-level narrative for the exec pre-brief.

Laura, please confirm whether 10:00–11:30 PT on Tue, Mar 22 works and who from HelioSystems will be on the pre-brief (title or name is fine). I’ll hold tentative calendar blocks pending your confirmation.

Thanks —
David Kim
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Sponsor_prep_one_pager.docx (Docx, 120KB)]

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@heliosystems.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@heliosystems.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority: executive slot buffer + sponsor backfill plan for HelioSystems demo

Thanks, David — Tue, Mar 22 is OK for the team but a couple of constraints: Gavin can join for the first 22 minutes of the customer-facing demo only (he has another commitment at 10:52). Our VP of Product (Raj) would like to be on the pre-brief and the demo, but he also needs a 10-minute touchpoint with our internal engineering lead immediately after the demo.

Can you add a 15-minute private post-brief for our internal decision team (Raj + eng lead) directly after the demo? That will help us align on next steps before taking any internal action items. Also — could you keep the exec pre-brief focused on outcome and risk (rather than nuts-and-bolts) so Gavin can get value in a short window.

Laura
Director, Strategic Partnerships
HelioSystems

Thanks for the detail, David — and great callout, Laura. A couple of operational asks to keep this tight:

- David: please create two invites: (1) "Executive pre-brief (Helio)" — private, includes Gavin + Raj + Redwood execs — 30m at 10:00; (2) "Customer-facing demo" — shared invite for the full demo. Add a 15-minute private post-brief for Helio decision team (as Laura requested).
- Karthik: confirm you can be listed as the backup sponsor for the 10:50–11:15 block and that you’re ready to take a 5-minute lightning demo of the business outcomes if Gavin exits early.

Also attaching a short run-of-show template and an annotated slide we will use in the exec pre-brief. If we keep the pre-brief to outcomes, Gavin will get signal quickly.

Cheers —

Laura — appreciate the precision. I’ve held the blocks as Marissa suggested and added a 15-minute private post-brief for HelioSystems. Calendar invites will show tentative attendees until you confirm names.

Two quick operational notes:
1) I’ve attached the exec run-of-show and a lightweight SOW outline so Raj has context for procurement questions.
2) Marissa and I will do a 20-minute technical dry run on Mon, Mar 21 at 2:00 PM PT — would either of you like to join? We’ll rehearse the handoff in case Gavin transitions out mid-demo so the narrative stays coherent.

Attachments: Redwood_exec_run_of_show.pdf, SOW_outline_v1.xlsx (see attachments list)

If that all looks good, I’ll send the final invites and include a 10-minute private "tech backstage" window for Redwood folks 10 minutes before the start so we can test audio/video privately.

Best,
David Kim
